Onda • downloads de vídeo, áudio e fotos:
ONDA • Video, audio and photo downloads

1. The portable app and installer include the required tools.
2. In Links & queue, choose Video, Photos / carousel or Full post.
3. Paste links, choose a format and add them to the queue.
4. Click Download queue. The progress bar tracks each transfer.

Social media: paste the post link. Instagram and Twitter/X detect photos and videos automatically. Posts with more than two media items open a selection window. The type is automatic for posts with only photos or videos; Photos / carousel filters images in mixed posts. Full post also saves original videos. If login is required, select cookies.txt in Settings. Access depends on the platform.

Spotify / Deezer / Apple: the queue finds matching audio on YouTube and applies tags and artwork. Without the Spotify API, metadata comes from an equivalent track on Deezer or Apple. This app does not export DRM-protected music.

FLAC uses lossless compression, but converting MP3/AAC/Opus to FLAC does not restore the original audio. Original avoids re-encoding.

Format, folder and playlist settings are captured when an item is added. Cancel stops the queue; retrying may resume .part files. Pending items are saved and restored paused when the app opens. Use your own or authorized content.

Onda • downloads de vídeo, áudio e fotos:
ONDA • Video, audio and photo downloads

1. The portable app and installer include the required tools.
2. In Links, choose Video, Photos / carousel or Full post.
3. Paste links, choose a format and add them to the queue.
4. Click Download queue. The progress bar tracks each transfer.

Social media: paste the post link. Instagram and Twitter/X detect photos and videos automatically. Posts with more than two media items open a selection window. The type is automatic for posts with only photos or videos; Photos / carousel filters images in mixed posts. Full post also saves original videos. If login is required, select cookies.txt in Settings. Access depends on the platform.

Spotify / Deezer / Apple: the queue finds matching audio on YouTube and applies tags and artwork. Without the Spotify API, metadata comes from an equivalent track on Deezer or Apple. This app does not export DRM-protected music.

FLAC uses lossless compression, but converting MP3/AAC/Opus to FLAC does not restore the original audio. Original avoids re-encoding.

Format, folder and playlist settings are captured when an item is added. Cancel stops the queue; retrying may resume .part files. Pending items are saved and restored paused when the app opens. Use your own or authorized content.
